summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Tax Reporting features. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Tax Summary section works correctly with all report types (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly), proper color coding for Net Profit (green for positive, red for negative), and PDF/Excel exports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tax Reporting feature fully tested. Backend: GET /api/reports returns total_sales, total_expenses, net_profit, total_salaries, total_other_expenses, net_margin_pct with previous period comparisons. Quarterly date parsing works with formats '2026-Q1' or '2026-1'. PDF export includes Tax Summary table. Excel export includes Tax Summary rows. Frontend: Reports page at /reports with 4 tabs (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly), Tax Summary section with data-testid='tax-summary-section', individual rows tax-row-sales, tax-row-raw-materials, tax-row-salaries, tax-row-other, tax-row-total-expenses, tax-row-net-profit, tax-row-net-margin. Previous iterations 1-11 all passed.
